paragraphs: Rav Papa, son of Rav Yosef.
Mentioned in [Bava Metzia 113b (113a in the linked edition)](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.113a.11): he explained [a teaching] before Rav Yosef.[^1]

notes.text: The linked passage has Rav Pappa son of Rav Nachman or, in the alternative, Rav Pappa son of Rav Yosef explain the baraita before Rav Yosef. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2990&lang=en) also cites the end of 113a.
